content.title: How to watch Iowa vs. Florida men’s basketball: Second Round TV channel and streaming options for March 22
content.text: The No. 1 seed Florida Gators (27-7) take to the court against the No. 9 seed Iowa Hawkeyes (22-12) with a Sweet 16 berth up for grabs on Sunday at Benchmark International Arena.How to watch Iowa Hawkeyes vs. Florida Gators Venue: Benchmark International Arena Time: 7:10 p.m. ET TV: TBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Iowa vs. Florida odds Spread: Florida -9.5 (-110), Iowa +9.5 (-110) Favorite Moneyline: Florida -495 Underdog Moneyline: Iowa +370 Total: 142.5 Total Over Odds: -110 Total Under Odds: -110 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Florida has a +547 scoring differential, topping opponents by 16.1 points per game. It is putting up 87.6 points per game to rank eighth in college basketball and is allowing 71.5 per outing to rank 111th in college basketball. Florida makes 7.4 three-pointers per game (210th in college basketball) compared to its opponents’ 6.7. It shoots 31.2% from deep while its opponents hit 32.2% from long range. Iowa outscores opponents by 9.2 points per game (posting 75.0 points per game, 201st in college basketball, and giving up 65.8 per outing, 15th in college basketball) and has a +311 scoring differential. Iowa hits 8.0 three-pointers per game (158th in college basketball), 1.4 more than its opponents.
